item.title: ¿Quién se postula para gobernador de California? Aquí un vistazo a los candidatos actuales
item.description: Pocas controversias han afectado a una contienda por lo demás tranquila y abierta para ser el próximo gobernador de California.

item.title: California must let immigrant truck drivers keep their licenses, judge rules
item.description: Facing pressure from the Trump administration, California tried to revoke more than 20,000 trucking licenses from certain immigrants, including many asylum seekers. In a tentative ruling, a Bay Area judge said these drivers should be able to keep their licenses, at least temporarily.

item.title: No clear frontrunner for governor, but new poll names five with the best shot
item.description: A poll shows three Democrats and two Republicans have voter support percentages in the teens. The top two vote-getters in June will face off in November.

item.title: He saw an abandoned trailer. Then, he uncovered a surveillance network on California’s border
item.description: Southern California residents are noticing new license plate readers that appear to be operated by the Border Patrol. Some have had confusing encounters with agents.

item.title: She spent six of her last years in arbitration with her HMO. Her husband’s still fighting the system
item.description: Arbitrators in medical disputes are supposed to be unbiased, but this couple suspected there is an incentive to favor HMO’s in arbitration.

item.title: AI images scandalized a California elementary school. Now the state is pushing new safeguards
item.description: Adobe's artificial intelligence generated sexualized images in response to prompts for a 4th grade book project. The incident coincided with the release of new state guidelines to prevent harmful AI in schools.

item.title: More government surveillance found along CA’s southern border
item.description: If you’re driving down California’s southern border, there’s a chance that a trailer or construction barrel you passed has a hidden camera in it operated by the federal government. item.title: Newsom changed California prisons. What will the justice system look like after he leaves?
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom pushed California's prison system to embrace rehabilitation for incarcerated people. Will it be a lasting shift?

item.title: ‘Tonight isn’t about bullets and targets. It’s about boundaries’: Residents denounce ICE contract
item.description: Despite hundreds of residents voicing their opposition to a contract with ICE to share the use of a police firing range, the Escondido City Council declined to cancel the agreement during a five-hour meeting on Wednesday night.

item.title: Santa Barbara judge rules against company that turned to Trump for help restarting pipeline
item.description: A Santa Barbara judge tentatively ruled that the Trump administration's intervention wasn't enough to let Sable Offshore restart a pipeline shut after a 2015 oil spill.
